flags: Animoto lacks SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and other enterprise compliance certifications, and there is no dedicated trust center.
Animoto had a significant data breach in 2018 affecting approximately 22 million users, and UpGuard reports infostealer malware was detected on its systems.
UpGuard identified no Content Security Policy (CSP) header, DNSSEC, or CAA records, which increases XSS, clickjacking, and DNS spoofing risks.
Animoto's UpGuard security rating of B (784/950) indicates a moderate security posture, not an enterprise-grade one.
The product offers 'AI video maker' features, but there is no public documentation on whether customer data is used for model training or whether an opt-out is available.
With no trust center and no major certifications, Animoto is suitable for SMB and marketing use but not for regulated industries or sensitive data.
On the positive side, Standard Contractual Clauses and data protection measures are documented for EU (GDPR) compliance.
